description: This file contains functions for validating host configuration, including checking Linux kernel version and user group memberships, specifically for the Android Open Source Project's virtualization environment.

methods.name: UserInGroup
methods.description: Checks if the user is in a specified group and adds commands to configure if not.

methods.name: GetLinuxVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the Linux kernel version as a pair of major and minor numbers.

methods.name: LinuxVersionAtLeast
methods.description: Checks if the current Linux version is at least a specified version.

methods.name: ValidateHostConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the host environment configuration, including kernel version and user groups.
